title: Design System: Perfect Saturday · Delhi NCR

display-bill.purpose: Plan title on the saffron bill. 34px mobile, 44px from 640px.

display-showtime.purpose: Start times in the Night showtime tiles, marquee yellow. 26px mobile, 30px from 640px.

title.purpose: Stop names and the console title. App title 20px / 26px; small display headings 18px.

body.purpose: The one reading size of the plan column: copy, metadata, travel lines, badges.

figure.purpose: Bill totals and the 88px price column, tabular.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, 'Why it fits:' and 'Trade-off:' leads.

console-log.purpose: Mono step names and logs inside the agent console only; console meta 12px, stats 16px.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: The system's one easing for authored and run-state motion.

motion.name: bill-paint-in
motion.value: 820ms ease-expo-out, scaleX(0.04) to scaleX(1) from the left on the bill's ::before field
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance: the saffron field brushes in behind already-visible text when a plan lands.

motion.name: sparkle-turn
motion.value: 1.6s ease-expo-out infinite, rotate 0 to 180deg with scale 0.86 to 1
motion.purpose: Run-state feedback while the agent works.

motion.name: status-in
motion.value: 380ms ease-expo-out, opacity 0 and translateY(6px) to rest
motion.purpose: Each new thinking phrase rises in.

motion.name: skeleton-fade
motion.purpose: Placeholder stops while the first plan builds.

motion.name: plan-dim
motion.purpose: The existing plan dims while an update runs.

narrative.overview:
The plan is a hand-painted bill outside a Delhi single-screen cinema, and the stops are its showtimes. Flat enamel-paint fields sit on a near-white ground: a night-indigo header bar and showtime tiles, one saffron bill carrying the plan title, magenta reserved for the action, and a deep hoarding-teal console where the agent's work is shown in full. Display lettering (Yatra One) is the hoarding painter's hand; everything that has to be read stays in one legible body face at one size.

Density is moderate and phone-first. A single plan column reads top to bottom at 360px; on desktop the teal console takes a fixed right panel. Hierarchy comes from paint field, hue and weight rather than from a ladder of text sizes. The world is light only: people plan in daylight on a phone, so there is no night variant (`color-scheme: light`).

Confirmed rejection: the category default of white itinerary cards with a map pane.
keyCharacteristics: Flat enamel fields, no shadows; depth is paint against ground.
One reading size (16px) across the plan column; hierarchy by hue and weight.
One corner radius (12px) on every field, card, control and badge.
Lettered display face only for the app title, plan title, stop names, showtimes and a few headings.
Every stop carries a visible source badge; real and sample data are never confused.
The agent console is a whole region painted teal, with real logs in mono.

rules.name: The One Bill Rule
rules.body: Saffron appears once per plan, as the bill field. A second saffron element dilutes the poster.

rules.name: The Magenta Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Magenta marks what you can do next (action, focus, selection). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Console Owns Teal Rule
rules.body: Hoarding Teal is a region, not an accent. In the plan column it appears only as the selected Agent trace tab, the doorway to the console.

rules.name: The One Reading Size Rule
rules.body: The plan column reads at 16px. Emphasis is weight (700) or hue (good, warn, muted), never a smaller size.

rules.name: The Lettering Is for Billing Rule
rules.body: Yatra One sets names and times: app title, plan title, stop names, showtimes, a few headings. Never body, buttons, labels or figures.

rules.name: The Mono Means Logs Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is literally tool names, prompt versions and run ids. Times and money use tabular figures in the body face.

rules.name: The Enamel Rule
rules.body: Fields are solid paint. No shadows, gradients or blur.

rules.name: The One Corner Rule
rules.body: 12px, everywhere. No pills, no square corners.

dos: Do keep one saffron bill per plan and let it carry the title and totals.
Do set times in the Night showtime tile with lettered marquee-yellow numerals, joined by the dashed travel line.
Do keep plan-column text at 16px and build emphasis from weight and hue.
Do use the 12px corner on every shape.
Do show a source badge on every stop and keep Sample data in Rust.
Do reserve Magenta Action for the primary action, focus and selection.
Do use tabular figures in the body face for times, prices and counts.
Do draw icons from the one SVG set at a 1.75 stroke.
Do keep the world light only.
donts: Don't use white itinerary cards with a map pane as the plan's form.
Don't add shadows, gradients or blur; fields are flat enamel.
Don't set body copy, buttons, labels or figures in Yatra One.
Don't use JetBrains Mono outside the agent console.
Don't set marquee yellow as text on white, or use Hoarding Teal as an accent in the plan column.
Don't add a second authored entrance; the bill paint-in is the one.
Don't use pills or square corners.
